name: The Victoria
summary: A Victorian corner pub run by the Jaguar Shoes group since 2015, with a preserved 1950s bar, food and a beer garden. Its live music room has been part of London's independent scene since the 1980s.

music.notes: Gigs in the live room, along with DJs and a mixed range of club nights.

crowd: Calls itself an easy-going Hackney local and a community pub.

evidence.quote: PUB FOOD ~ LEGENDARY LIVE MUSIC ~ BEER GARDEN 451 QUEENSBRIDGE RD, E8 3AS
A FRIENDLY, LAID-BACK HACKNEY LOCAL WITH DEEP EAST LONDON ROOTS.
THE VENUE IS A FIXTURE OF LONDON'S INDEPENDENT MUSIC SCENE, HOSTING LIVE ACTS, DJS AND ECLECTIC CLUB NIGHTS.
The Victoria is an East London community pub with more than a century of history behind it. Behind the beautifully preserved 1950s bar
Our legendary live room has been a fixture of London's independent music scene since the 1980s.
